# Image quality fixture provenance

`srgb.icc` is a 588-byte sRGB profile generated locally, without external artwork
or downloaded profiles. It was created using Pillow's `ImageCms` wrapper around
LittleCMS 2.19 (Pillow 12.3.0) on 2026-10-26:

```python
from PIL import ImageCms
profile = ImageCms.ImageCmsProfile(ImageCms.createProfile("sRGB"))
with open("srgb.icc", "wb") as output:
    output.write(profile.tobytes())
```

Profile description: `sRGB built-in`. The ICC header records `RGB ` data space,
`XYZ ` connection space and `acsp` signature. Tests verify the declared length
and signature, and Imagick recognizes the complete profile embedded in the
source JPEG. Creation timestamps may differ when regenerating the profile;
byte identity is asserted against the committed fixture during backup/restore,
not against newly generated profile bytes. No wide-gamut accuracy is claimed.

JPEG EXIF/APP segments and all JPEG/PNG pixels are generated by the PHP quality
probe. The 96×64 image uses fixed red, green, blue and yellow quadrants to expose
rotations and reflections. PNGs include palette+tRNS and truecolor alpha; large
inert metadata makes successful recompression smaller without changing pixels.
Corrupt PNGs retain a valid IHDR and replace IDAT with invalid zlib bytes, so
readable dimensions cannot stand in for successful image decoding.
